# Litecoin Swap

> Litecoin Swap is a non-custodial web interface for swapping LTC to and from assets on other chains. Litecoin is a proof-of-work chain without smart contracts, so these swaps are cross-chain: users send from their own wallet, review a quote with fees and an estimated time, and the asset is delivered to their destination address.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Litecoin Swap covers LTC to and from assets such as USDT, USDC and ETH on other chains.
- Litecoin is its own proof-of-work chain with no smart contracts, so LTC swaps are cross-chain.
- Sending LTC pays a miner fee in LTC; a route or bridge fee is built into the quoted amount.
- Completion time depends on source-chain confirmations and route settlement, so quotes show estimates.
- The interface is non-custodial: it never holds funds or keys and the user approves every transfer.

## Pages
